authentication.md.content: The system must provide secure authentication for registered users.

- Users must sign in using an email address and password.
- Email addresses must be unique and case-insensitive.
- Passwords must contain at least 12 characters.
- Passwords must include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.
- Users must receive an error message when authentication fails.
- The system must lock an account after five failed attempts within 15 minutes.
- Locked accounts must automatically unlock after 30 minutes.
- Users must be able to reset their password using a verified email address.

- Passwords must never be stored as plain text.
- Authentication requests must use HTTPS.
- User sessions must expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.

customer_onboarding.md.content: The system must allow internal users to create and manage customer profiles.

- An employee must provide the customer's legal name, email address, phone number, and country.
- The system must validate the customer email address.
- The system must prevent duplicate customers with the same email address.
- New customers must initially have the status Pending.
- A customer must be approved before they can create orders.
- The system must record who approved the customer and when.
- Employees must be able to search customers by name, email, or status.

- Customer creation must be recorded in the audit log.
- Customer updates must record the previous and new values.
- Audit records must not be deleted by regular employees.

invoice_approval.txt.content:
Invoice Approval Requirements

The system must support a two-level invoice approval workflow.

Invoices below 1,000 EUR require approval from one finance employee.

Invoices from 1,000 EUR up to 10,000 EUR require approval from a finance manager.

Invoices above 10,000 EUR require approval from both a finance manager and a department director.

The invoice creator cannot approve their own invoice.

An approver must be notified by email when an invoice is waiting for approval.

Approvers must be able to approve or reject an invoice.

A rejected invoice must include a rejection reason.

The system must record the approval decision, approver, timestamp, and comments.

The system must record the approval decision, approver, timestamp, and comments.

Approved invoices cannot be edited unless they are reopened by a finance manager.
